messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@veridata-llc.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offboarding proofflow & training roster for SIG/CAIQ review

Elena —

Per our SIG intake, attaching the initial artifacts you requested related to personnel lifecycle controls. Key items in this batch: a training roster extract for Q1–Q2 2026, a redacted index of background checks (we kept PII redacted per your guidance), and our offboard chain-of-custody workbook.

Ask: can you confirm whether the redaction level here meets Veridata’s minimum criteria (only last 4 of SSN, employment dates, role/title allowed)? If you need more fields unredacted for sampling, we can arrange a secure upload to the portal and provide a short justification for your audit team.

Notes:
- We marked contractor rows separately in the roster.
- Offboard workbook includes the ticket IDs and deprovision timestamps for access systems (Okta, GCP projects, Vault).

Attaching: training_roster_Q1-Q2-2026.csv (sample), redacted_bg_checks_index.pdf, offboard_chain_of_custody.xlsx

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Compliance Enablement, Redwood Inference
H: +1 415-555-0197 | hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@veridata-llc.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit-portal@veridata-llc.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offboarding proofflow & training roster for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the early delivery and the clear inventory. A couple quick items from the Veridata audit team: we need
1) a mapping document that explains how "contractor" rows are defined (payroll vs. contractor vendors), and
2) for a 10% sample we will need unredacted background check PDFs for selected IDs (we will sign an NDA for PII access).

Redaction level looks consistent with what we usually accept, but confirmation on the contractor mapping will help us classify control ownership in SIG rows.

Can you also add a row in the offboard workbook that indicates whether the deprovisioning was automated (via orchestration) or manual, and include the responsible engineer/team? That helps with our control maturity notes.

If you prefer, we can provision a temporary secure bucket and a DocuSign PII-access addendum; please let me know which you want to proceed with.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Audit Manager, Veridata Analytics
elena.ruiz@veridata-llc.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@veridata-llc.com>
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offboarding proofflow & training roster for SIG/CAIQ review

Elena —

Quick answers inline:

> we need a mapping document that explains how "contractor" rows are defined
Attached: contractor_definition_matrix.pdf (stub) — contractors are defined as non-payroll workers engaged via a vendor PO or 1099 engagement; column "employment_status" in the roster is the source of truth.

> for a 10% sample we will need unredacted background check PDFs
We can provide the 10% samples. Process: once DocuSign PII addendum executed we will upload to the secure bucket and share access to your audit account.

> add a row indicating whether deprovisioning was automated or manual and include responsible engineer/team
Updated offboard_chain_of_custody.xlsx: new column "deprov_process" with values {automated, manual} and "owner_team" populated. See tab "summary_for_audit".

Attachments in this reply: contractor_definition_matrix.pdf (attachment stub), updated_offboard_chain_of_custody.xlsx (attachment stub)

Next steps: Hannah / Aditya — can you review the contractor matrix wording (one-liner under definition) and confirm we have permission to add the 10% PII samples to Veridata via the DocuSign flow? I will prepare the portal upload checklist once we have DocuSign signed.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Elena / Veridata team —

Confirming we will:
- Execute the DocuSign PII addendum (I asked Legal to prioritize; DocuSign envelope queued: DocuSign: 0x23F-VERIDATA-SIG)
- Provide the 10% unredacted sample to the secure bucket and notify audit-portal@veridata-llc.com when the upload is complete.
- Marissa has updated the offboard workbook with deprovisioning automation flags and owner_team values.
- Aditya will run a final sweep to ensure access logs (Okta/GCP) referenced in the workbook include ticket links for triage if Veridata wants to sample event-level evidence.

Action owners:
- Legal / Hannah: finish DocuSign by EOD Thu 6/24
- Marissa: prepare portal upload checklist and sample list by Fri 6/25
- Aditya: export access-event CSV for sampled tickets by Fri 6/25

Elena, please confirm whether we should upload to the Veridata portal folder (preferred) or if you want us to provision a one-time bucket; we will proceed with portal unless you ask otherwise.

Regards,
Hannah
